row:
Marine biologist & PhD student sharing my experience with research and the pursuit of a career in marine biology & conservation. On this channel I love talking about careers that work with the ocean and the professional tools and tips that help you achieve goals related to that. 🧜🏼‍♂️ Thanks so much for your interest!

If you're interested in learning more, consider connecting with me on Instagram @ecology_eli & @ocean.scholar!
